60566117.title: Multo_(song)
60566117.extract:
# Multo (song)

Multo is a 2024 single by the Filipino band Cup of Joe, released by Viva Records and sung in Filipino. Announced as a surprise on September 13, 2024 and commercially issued digitally on September 14, 2024, the track later appeared on the band’s debut album Silakbo in January 2025. Media coverage in the Philippines characterized the song as a melancholic synth‑pop/pop‑rock ballad about being “haunted” by lingering emotions after loss or a breakup. In April 2025, Billboard Philippines reported that Multo made chart history by debuting on the Billboard Global 200, with GMA News likewise reporting the global entry; the song also reached No. 1 in the Philippines on Billboard Philippines’ Hot 100 and finished 2025 as the top song on both Spotify Philippines and Apple Music Philippines. At the inaugural Filipino Music Awards (FMA) in October 2025, Multo won Song of the Year. The title “Multo” (“ghost” in Filipino) has been used by other Philippine artists for separate songs; among these releases, Cup of Joe’s Multo has received the widest independent coverage and national recognition. 

## Identification and release

- Primary artist and language: Cup of Joe; the lyrics are in Filipino, as shown in the official lyric video. 
- Country/market and label: Philippines; Viva Records (©/℗ 2024). 
- Release dates and formats:
 - Surprise announcement on September 13, 2024 via media coverage. 
 - Digital single release on September 14, 2024 (Apple Music and Spotify metadata). 
 - Listed on Discogs as a digital AAC single; Discogs records a November 14, 2024 entry for the AAC single format. 
- Inclusion on album: Later included on Cup of Joe’s debut album Silakbo, released in January 2025 (as reported by GMA News and PULP Magazine). 
- Duration: 3:57 (Spotify track page). 
- Cover art: The single’s cover accompanies the official streaming product pages and the band’s official YouTube lyric video upload. Credits and licensing details are listed on the official lyric video page. 

## Credits and creation

- Songwriters: Raphaell Ridao and Redentor Immanuel Ridao. 
- Producers: Shadiel Chan (official lyric video); PULP Magazine’s report credits both Shadiel Chan and Jovel Rivera as producers on the track. 
- Arrangers: Raphaell Ridao, Redentor Immanuel Ridao, Shadiel Chan, and Cup of Joe. 
- Recording and mixing engineer: Shadiel Chan. 
- Mastering: Jan Aries Agadier Fuertez. 
- Publisher: Viva Music Publishing, Inc. 
- Label: Viva Records. 

These credits derive from the band’s official lyric video upload, which serves as the primary source for liner-style information; PULP Magazine corroborates and expands the producer credits in its coverage of the music video release and album context. 

## Composition and lyrics

Press coverage described Multo as a melancholic single blending synth‑pop and pop‑rock elements, marked by a “lingering” hook and more “ambitious and experimental” sonics for the band compared with their previous releases. Billboard Philippines characterized the track as one that “hits you straight in the feels,” examining “the ghosts of our past” and the clarity in the ruins of failed relationships. Rolling Stone Philippines framed Multo as the song that reshaped Cup of Joe’s image “from upbeat pop performers to serious storytellers,” noting its slow-burn rise as audiences connected with its themes on social media. The lyrics, entirely in Filipino, use ghostly imagery (“Minumulto na ’ko ng damdamin ko,” “Dinadalaw mo ’ko bawat gabi”) to convey lingering memories and emotional haunting. 

## Background and release

Billboard Philippines reported that Cup of Joe announced Multo as a surprise single on September 13, 2024, just three hours before release, positioning it as the next entry after the band’s 2024 run of Misteryoso and Lahat Ng Bukas. The digital single went live on major platforms on September 14, 2024, and the track was later included on the January 2025 debut album Silakbo. Rolling Stone Philippines’ feature situated Multo within the band’s broader shift toward introspective storytelling and chronicled the song’s growth over months—citing audience engagement, a widely viewed stripped-down live performance, and a broader pattern of long-tail hits on Philippine charts. 

## Music video

- Release and director: The official music video for Multo was released in March 2025 and directed by Kris Cazin. 
- Cast: Elijah Canlas and Miles Ocampo star in the video. 
- Creative concept: GMA News reported that the band wrote the screenplay themselves, with the narrative juxtaposing domestic scenes of togetherness against moments of isolation and hallucination, suggesting a loved one’s presence as a ghost. PULP Magazine similarly described the video’s cinematic portrayal of love, loss, and lingering emotions. 
- Official upload: The music video is available on Cup of Joe’s official YouTube channel. 

## Reception

- Critical commentary:
 - Billboard Philippines: Gabriel Saulog wrote that Multo “hits you straight in the feels” and is “a bit more ambitious and experimental” sonically, with “a hook that lingers deep upon its first full listen.” 
 - Rolling Stone Philippines: The outlet argued Multo marked Cup of Joe’s “arrival as serious pop storytellers,” highlighting its slow-burn breakthrough and the band’s transformation. 
- Year-end recognition:
 - Spotify Philippines named Multo the country’s top song of 2025. 
 - Apple Music Philippines listed Multo at No. 1 on its Top OPM Songs of 2025. 
- Awards:
 - Filipino Music Awards (FMA) 2025: Multo won Song of the Year, as reported by Bandwagon Asia’s coverage of the event held at SM Mall of Asia Arena. 

## Commercial performance

- Global charts:
 - Billboard Global 200: Billboard Philippines reported Cup of Joe as the first Filipino act to debut on the Billboard Global 200, with Multo entering at No. 181 for the chart tracked by Luminate; GMA News likewise reported the global entry. 
 - Billboard Global Excl. U.S.: Billboard Philippines noted a debut at No. 74 for Multo on the Global Excl. U.S. chart, calling it the highest debut and the first Filipino song to reach the Top 100 on that chart. 
- Philippines:
 - Billboard Philippines Hot 100: According to Billboard Philippines’ official channels, Multo reached No. 1 on the Hot 100 and sustained a lengthy run at the top; a post by Billboard Philippines stated the song held the No. 1 position on the Hot 100 and Top Philippine Songs charts for 27 weeks. 
- Streaming and video:
 - Wish 107.5 Bus live performance: A widely viewed official performance video underscored the song’s popularity. 

Note: Chart rankings and milestones are attributed to Billboard Philippines (for both national and global chart reporting) and GMA News (for coverage of the Global 200 entry). 

## Live performances

- Wish 107.5 Bus: Cup of Joe performed Multo live in a wishclusive session published on June 11, 2025. 
- Billboard Philippines Studios: The band delivered an exclusive live session of Multo and Misteryoso, published on December 5, 2025. 
- Stripped-down performance: A Cozy Cove live version emphasized the song’s raw, melancholic tone. 
- Arena performance: The SM Mall of Asia Arena’s official page highlighted Cup of Joe performing Multo live, reflecting its prominence in major concert settings. 

## Cultural presence and media

- TikTok/virality: GMA News reported that Multo’s popularity surged on TikTok, with fan edits and trends contributing to its rise, and referenced fan content involving notable local love-team edits that helped spread the song. 
- Cross-artist renditions: Rappler’s channels reported a K‑pop group NTX cover of Multo, indicative of the song’s reach beyond OPM circles. 
- Playlists and curation: Apple Music featured Multo prominently in OPM playlists and year-end curations, reflecting its sustained popularity across the year. 

## Other songs titled “Multo”

“Multo” is a common Tagalog term meaning “ghost,” and several unrelated songs share the title. These releases are distinct from Cup of Joe’s single and do not appear to have comparable independent national media coverage:

- Magnus Haven — Multo (2020): Available on Spotify; lyrics pages are cataloged on Genius. 
- JERGE — Multo (2024): Released as a single with an official music video; documented on streaming platforms and lyric sites. 
- Healy After Dark — Multo (2024): Released via O/C Records with official audio and lyric video uploads; label-provided metadata is available on YouTube. 

Additionally, The Youth’s catalog includes the track “Multo Sa Paningin – Multong Bakla,” which uses “multo” in its title but is not simply titled “Multo.” This appears on releases documented by MusicBrainz and compilation listings. 

If multiple encyclopedia entries were to be created, a disambiguation page would be appropriate to distinguish among these unrelated songs. Based on the breadth of independent coverage, Cup of Joe’s Multo demonstrably meets general notability standards via significant reporting in national music media, chart publications, and year-end lists, whereas other tracks titled “Multo” are primarily documented through platform listings and label uploads. 

## Notability synthesis

Cup of Joe’s Multo is covered by multiple independent, reliable sources with significant depth:

- Music journalism and features: Billboard Philippines (release news, chart reporting), Rolling Stone Philippines (feature analysis), PULP Magazine (music video release and album context), GMA News (MV coverage and chart entry). 
- Official chart bodies and year-end lists: Billboard Global 200/Global Excl. U.S. entries reported by Billboard Philippines and GMA News; No. 1 song status in Spotify Philippines’ year-end and Apple Music Philippines’ Top OPM Songs of 2025 via ABS‑CBN outlets. 
- Awards: Song of the Year at the Filipino Music Awards (Bandwagon Asia). 

This breadth of independent coverage, chart documentation, and formal recognition supports the song’s standalone notability, clearly distinguishing it from other releases sharing the title.

## Track information

- Title: Multo 
- Artist: Cup of Joe 
- Language: Filipino 
- Label: Viva Records (©/℗ 2024) 
- Release: Announced September 13, 2024; digital single released September 14, 2024; later included on Silakbo (January 2025). 
- Duration: 3:57. 
- Credits: Songwriters – Raphaell Ridao, Redentor Immanuel Ridao; Producers – Shadiel Chan (also credited alongside Jovel Rivera in press); Arrangers – Raphaell Ridao, Redentor Immanuel Ridao, Shadiel Chan, Cup of Joe; Recording/Mixing – Shadiel Chan; Mastering – Jan Aries Agadier Fuertez; Publisher – Viva Music Publishing, Inc. 

## Release history

- Digital single: Philippines/Global – September 14, 2024 (Apple Music/Spotify). 
- Album appearance: Silakbo (January 2025). 
- Official videos:
 - Lyric video: YouTube (published September 13, 2024). 
 - Music video: YouTube (released March 2025).

Cup of Joe’s ‘Multo’ Proves a Sad Banger Can Still Be a Breakthrough
====================================================================

The Baguio boyband known for bops embraces heartbreak, and ‘Multo’ quietly rewrites their legacy.

By [](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/music/cup-of-joes-multo-proves-a-sad-banger-can-still-be-a-breakthrough/)[Elijah Pareño](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/author/elijah-pareno/ "Posts by Elijah Pareño")April 11, 2025

[![Image 15: Facebook](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/wp-content/themes/rollingstone-philippines/addtoany/icons/facebook.svg)](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/#facebook "Facebook")[![Image 16: Twitter](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/wp-content/themes/rollingstone-philippines/addtoany/icons/twitter.svg)](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/#twitter "Twitter")[![Image 17: Email](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/wp-content/themes/rollingstone-philippines/addtoany/icons/email.svg)](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/#email "Email")[![Image 18: Copy Link](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/wp-content/themes/rollingstone-philippines/addtoany/icons/link.svg)](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/#copy_link "Copy Link")

![Image 19: Cup of Joe](https://b3745597.smushcdn.com/3745597/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/RSPH-Landscape-66-e1744375269471.jpg?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

“Multo” now has 2.55 million daily streamPhoto from Cup of Joe/Facebook

The synth-pop ballad “Multo” by Cup of Joe shouldn’t have worked for the Baguio-based band. Known for their charismatic stage performance and the dual vocals of Gian Bernardino and Raphael Ridao, the group built their name on upbeat pop that’s bred from the pine trees of Baguio City. Yet when they released the melancholic track last October, months before the official release of their debut album _Silakbo_, it revealed an emotional depth fans hadn’t anticipated.

Initially overlooked, “Multo” has since become a slow-burning phenomenon, joining other surprise hits like [Hev Abi’](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/tag/hev-abi/ "Hev Abi")s “Alam Mo Ba Girl” and Maki’s “Dilaw” in dominating charts long after release. But for Cup of Joe, it was an artistic awakening. The lyrics “Pasindi na ng ilaw/ Minumulto na ‘ko ng damdamin ko” resonate as a metaphor for the band’s own evolution, shedding their playful image to confront the ghosts of their musical journey. To add to the virality, some listeners have reinterpreted its ghostly imagery through deeply personal lenses: [TikTok](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/tag/tiktok/ "TikTok")users attribute it to lost loved ones, faded friendships, or even the specter of past selves. “Multo got me on a chokehold beh,” one comment reads, “feeling ko meron akong ex of 7 years.”

![Image 20: Cup of Joe](https://b3745597.smushcdn.com/3745597/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Untitled-design-21.webp?lossy=2&strip=1&webp=1)

_Silakbo_ revealed an emotional depth fans hadn’t anticipated. Photo from Cup of Joe/Facebook

Their stripped-down Cozy Cove performance, now amassing 3.3 million views as of this writing, showcased this transformation in the live footage. Gone were the theatrics; in their place stood raw vulnerability, with haunting lighting underscoring the song’s emotional weight. Even their sold-out two-night concert felt like vindication, proving their artistry extended beyond spectacle.

Advertisement

What makes “Multo” remarkable is its timing. Arriving after the initial hype of _Silakbo_, it defied the usual post-album slump, growing bigger than the band itself. Like Mayonnaise and [Kitchie Nadal](https://rollingstonephilippines.com/tag/kitchie-nadal/ "Kitchie Nadal")’s career resurgences, it reveals an essential truth: the most enduring art often simmers before it boils over, lingering like the ghost it’s named after, long after trends fade.

For a band once defined by youthful exuberance, “Multo” marks Cup of Joe’s arrival as serious pop storytellers. The numbers prove it, but the real victory lies in how a song about the past has become the foundation for their future.

**Editor’s Note:**This article was edited on October 29, 2025, to correct information regarding Cup of Joe’s origins as a boy band. They were, in fact, never a boy band due to the lack of stylized choreography in their repertoire.

4.title: Cup of Joe Releases ‘Multo’ Music Video | PULP Magazine
4.description: The cinematic MV stars Elijah Canlas and Miles Ocampo, with Miles portraying a woman grappling with the ghosts of her past.
4.content:
The cinematic MV stars Elijah Canlas and Miles Ocampo.

Acclaimed five-piece band **Cup of Joe** has just released the official music video for “Multo.”

_Multo - Cup of Joe (Official Music Video)_

A track from their latest album, _Silakbo_, “Multo” is produced by **Jovel Rivera** and **Shadiel Chan**, who also worked on its musical arrangement alongside the band and **Redentor Immanuel Ridao**. As of this writing, the track has amassed 23,898,152 streams on Spotify, cementing its status as one of the band’s most beloved songs.

Meanwhile, its cinematic music video, directed by Kris Cazin, stars **Elijah Canlas** and **Miles Ocampo** in an artful depiction of love and loss, capturing the lingering emotions of past relationships. Elijah and Miles are acclaimed actors known for their versatility, and in “Multo,” they bring depth and heart, amplifying the song’s poignant lyrics. Their performances not only showcase their talent but also reinforce the story the band set out to tell.

If you visit the band’s YouTube channel and check out the comments section of the “Multo” music video, fans are already raving about it. Some are sharing theories about the storyline, while others are reflecting on the song’s meaning. Garnering approximately 140,000 views within its first 24 hours and landing at No. 14 on YouTube’s Trending for Music chart, “Multo” has become a comforting presence for listeners as they process past relationships or lost loves, with the music video serving as the perfect complement.

_Silakbo_ takes listeners on an emotional journey through the five stages of grief—denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance—with two tracks representing each stage. Featuring ten songs of varying sounds and styles, the album cements Cup of Joe as one of the top acts in the OPM scene, showcasing their growth and versatility.

_Multo - Cup of Joe (M/V Behind The Scenes)_

With over six million monthly listeners and nearly two million followers on Spotify, Cup of Joe continues to make waves with hits like “Tingin” (featuring **Janine Teñoso**), “Misteryoso,” and “Estranghero.” Now, “Multo” joins that lineup, with its music video adding another layer of emotion to the song. - **_Andrea Dee/PULP_**

Cup of Joe drops 'Multo' music video starring Elijah Canlas and Miles Ocampo
============================================================================

 By GMA Integrated News

**Published** March 7, 2025 11:37am 

Cup of Joe has released the official music video for their song “Multo,” starring Elijah Canlas and Miles Ocampo.

ADVERTISEMENT

With screenplay written by the band themselves, the music video follows Miles, who experiences hallucinations of her partner, Elijah. They are shown having happy moments in the house they shared, but the scenes then cut to Miles being alone, while Elijah is presumably a ghost.

“Multo” is part of Cup of Joe’s debut album “[Silakbo](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/lifestyle/hobbiesandactivities/933185/cup-of-joe-drops-debut-album-silakbo/story/),” released in January.

Cup of Joe is a pop-rock band from Baguio. Formed in 2018, the band’s lineup consists of lead vocalists Gian Bernardino and Raphael Ridao, lead guitarist Gabriel Fernandez, rhythm guitarist CJ Fernandez, keyboardist Xen Gareza, and drummer Elian Akia.

In 2024, they released the music video for “[Misteryoso](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/lifestyle/hobbiesandactivities/915782/cup-of-joe-drops-misteryoso-mv-starring-bini-s-jhoanna-and-directed-by-sb19-s-justin/story/),” starring BINI’s Jhoanna and directed by SB19’s Justin.

The band is best known for their songs “Mananatili,” “Tingin” featuring Janine Tenoso, “Estranghero,” “Sinderela,” and “Tataya.”

Meanwhile, Miles and Elijah [confirmed their relationship](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/lifestyle/familyandrelationships/867556/elijah-canlas-on-keeping-relationship-with-miles-ocampo-private-we-just-choose-what-to-s/story/) in May 2022 and [broke up in 2023](https://www.gmanetwork.com/entertainment/showbiznews/relationship/19081/miles-ocampo-at-elijah-canlas-kumpirmadong-hiwalay-na/photo/258078/my-camille).

However, the two are rumored to have [rekindled their romance](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/lifestyle/familyandrelationships/930693/are-elijah-canlas-and-miles-ocampo-back-together/story/) as they were spotted at various events like dinner in Judy Ann Santos’ restaurant, and Jose Manalo and Gene Maranan’s beach wedding.**—Nika Roque/JCB, GMA Integrated News**

Cup Of Joe Summon The Ghosts Of Their Past On New Single “Multo” – Listen
=========================================================================

This marks their latest release since dropping the chart-topping “Misteryoso.”

By [Gabriel Saulog](https://billboardphilippines.com/author/gabriel-saulog/ "Posts by Gabriel Saulog")

September 16, 2024

[![Image 13: Facebook](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/facebook.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#facebook "Facebook")[![Image 14: X](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/x.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#x "X")[![Image 15: Telegram](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/telegram.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#telegram "Telegram")[![Image 16: Copy Link](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/link.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#copy_link "Copy Link")

![Image 17: A Filipino boy band, composed of five stylish men, are posing in front of a yellow background, with 2 men standing on top of the other 3 seated on a chair](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/cup-of-joe-ftr-img-fixed-1600x838.jpg)

Courtesy of @cupofm

Cup of Joe: courtesy of @cupofjoemusic.

[Cup Of Joe](https://billboardphilippines.com/music/news/cup-of-joe-announce-dos-the-sixth-joenniversary-special-concert-tickets-2024/ "Cup of Joe Announce ‘DOS: The Sixth JOEnniversary Special’") are here to haunt your ears for the better with their new single, titled “Multo.”

The new track came as a surprise release to their Joe-wahs and other fans last September 13, 2024 (Friday), as the group announced the track a mere three hours before its scheduled release.

Yet as many of their listeners have discovered, “Multo” hits you straight in the feels as it delivers a poignant examination of the ghosts of our past, leaving one with a little more clarity on the ruins of their failed relationships. Even sonically, the track itself is a bit more ambitious and experimental for the band, with a hook that lingers deep upon its first full listen.

”Multo” marks the latest entry in Cup Of Joe’s discography, and follows the release of their chart-topping single “Misteryoso” and “Lahat Ng Bukas,” featuring Keanna Mag. The group also released their first ever extended play (EP) _Patutunguhan_ late last year, which includes the hit single “Tingin” with Janine Teñoso.

Advertisement

Both “Tingin” and “Misteryoso” are currently charting on the _Billboard Philippines_ Hot 100 with their other single “Estranghero.” “Tingin” stands at No. 12, “Misteryoso” at No. 28, and “Estranghero” at No. 69. Together with many other chart-topping musicians, Cup Of Joe are set to take the grand stage for _Billboard Philippines_’ first-anniversary event, [_Mainstage_](https://billboardphilippines.com/music/how-to-secure-your-spot-at-billboard-philippines-mainstage-the-year-one-anniversary/ "How to Secure Your Spot at Billboard Philippines: Mainstage – The Year One Anniversary"), this October 15, 2024. Tickets to the show may be purchased [here](https://billboardphilippines.com/music/how-to-secure-your-spot-at-billboard-philippines-mainstage-the-year-one-anniversary/ "How to Secure Your Spot at Billboard Philippines: Mainstage – The Year One Anniversary").

Cup of Joe Are The First Filipino Act To Break Into The Billboard Global 200
============================================================================

The viral success of their hit single “Multo” has also paved the way for the track to debut on the _Billboard_ Global Excl. U.S. chart.

By [Gabriel Saulog](https://billboardphilippines.com/author/gabriel-saulog/ "Posts by Gabriel Saulog")

April 16, 2025

[![Image 14: Facebook](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/facebook.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#facebook "Facebook")[![Image 15: X](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/x.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#x "X")[![Image 16: Telegram](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/telegram.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#telegram "Telegram")[![Image 17: Copy Link](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/themes/billboardph/addtoany/icons/link.svg)](https://billboardphilippines.com/#copy_link "Copy Link")

![Image 18: Men stand against a red background and look to the right](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/cup-of-joe-multo-global-200-ftr-img-1600x838.jpg)

Photographed by Ban Naga.

Photographed by Ban Naga.

[Cup of Joe](https://billboardphilippines.com/tag/cup-of-joe/) have just made history as the first Filipino act to debut on the [_Billboard_ Global 200](https://www.billboard.com/charts/billboard-global-200/).

The breaking news for the Baguio-based band came as _Billboard_ updated their weekly chart rankings, showcasing the group’s viral hit “[Multo](https://billboardphilippines.com/music/news/cup-of-joe-summon-the-ghosts-of-their-past-on-new-single-multo-release-2024/ "Cup Of Joe Summon The Ghosts Of Their Past On New Single “Multo” – Listen")” positioned at the No. 181 spot of the _Billboard_ Global 200 chart. The track serves as the first-ever Filipino song to break into the chart, showcasing the alternative group’s rising impact on both the local and global stages.

![Image 19: cup of joe multo billboard global 200](https://billboardphilippines.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/cup-of-joe-multo-billboard-global-200-1600x747.png)

Courtesy of Billboard U.S.

Aside from making its way into the _Billboard_ Global 200 chart, Cup of Joe’s “Multo” also makes its way to the _Billboard_ Global Excl. U.S. chart at No. 74, which marks the highest debut and the first Filipino song to reach the Top 100 of the chart. The song follows the success of [Juan Karlos](https://billboardphilippines.com/tag/juan-karlos/)‘“ERE,” which debuted at the No. 138 spot on the _Billboard_ Global Excl. U.S. chart in October 2023 and was recognized as the first Filipino song in history to appear there.

“Multo” was first released last September 14, 2024, and served as the lead single off Cup of Joe’s debut album, [_Silakbo_](https://billboardphilippines.com/music/reviews/cup-of-joe-live-out-their-wildest-dreams-at-silakbo-concert-review/ "Cup Of Joe Live Out Their Wildest Dreams At ‘SILAKBO’ Concert – Review"). The track has continued to gain prominence across various local streaming and digital platforms, alongside an influx of social media posts and video edits on Instagram and TikTok that have used the song.

Advertisement

The _Billboard_ Global 200 tracks this week’s most popular songs based on streaming and sales activity from over 200 territories around the world — including the United States — as tracked by Luminate. The ranking is based on a weighted formula incorporating official-only streams on both subscription and ad-supported tiers of leading audio and video music services, plus download sales from top music retailers across the globe.

9.title: SB19, Cup of Joe, IV of Spades, Zild, Gloc-9 win big; Apl.de.Ap & BINI perform at Filipino Music Awards 2025
9.description: The inaugural Filipino Music Awards 2025, held on 21 October at the SM Mall of Asia Arena, marked a historic moment for OPM with a night full of fi...
9.content:
The inaugural **Filipino Music Awards 2025**, held on **21 October** at the SM Mall of Asia Arena, marked a historic moment for OPM with a night full of firsts, fanfare, and fiery performances. From veteran icons to next-gen pop royalty, the awards night drew over 500 artists, industry names, and fans—all united in celebrating the evolution of Filipino music.

**SB19** were undeniable scene-stealers, dominating the evening with six major wins including **Artist of the Year**, **Pop Song of the Year** for **‘Dungka!’**, **Tour of the Year**, **Concert of the Year**, and two fan-voted trophies: **People’s Choice Artist** and **People’s Choice Song**. Fellow crowd-favourite **Cup of Joe** had their own moment in the spotlight, winning **Song of the Year** with **‘Multo’** and **Album of the Year** for **_Silakbo_**.

The FMAs also championed genre diversity, awarding standout acts across alternative, rock, hip-hop, R&B, and folk. **Zild** picked up **Alternative Song of the Year** for **‘I.N.A.S.’**, **IV of Spades** bagged **Rock Song of the Year** with **‘Aura’**, and **Morobeats** won **Hip-Hop Song of the Year** for the powerful **‘Gubat na Siyudad’**. On the R&B front, **Denise Julia** scored with **‘Lackin’**, while **Ben&Ben**’s **‘Dear’** won **Folk Song of the Year**.

Performances were just as memorable. **IV of Spades** electrified the stage with **‘Aura’**, **BGYO** brought arena-level choreography, and **Gloc-9** lit up the arena with **‘Upuan’**. **BINI** fired up the crowd with a slick performance of **‘First Luv’**, while **Ben&Ben** and **SB19** united for a powerful rendition of **‘Kapangyarihan’**. **Ely Buendia** also made a wonderful live appearance with a moving performance of **‘Kandarapa’**. **apl.de.ap** turned things global with a fiery take on **‘WIND IT!’**, and **Cup of Joe** delivered a moving sing-along with **‘Multo’**.

The night also honoured legends: **Pilita Corrales** received the **Tribute Award**, **Jose Mari Chan** was awarded **Lifetime Achievement**, and **Ang Misyon Orchestra** was named **Music Foundation of the Year**.

The FMAs showed that OPM is entering a bold new era—genre-inclusive, globally ready, and powered by a passionate fanbase. It’s not just a celebration, it’s a launchpad.

### Full Winners List

**Artist of the Year**

*   SB19

**Song of the Year**

*   ‘Multo’ – Cup of Joe

**Album of the Year**

*   _Silakbo_ – Cup of Joe

**Pop Song of the Year**

*   ‘Dungka!’ – SB19

**Alternative Song of the Year**

*   ‘I.N.A.S.’ – Zild

**Rock Song of the Year**

*   ‘Aura’ – IV of Spades

**Hip-Hop Song of the Year**

*   ‘Gubat na Siyudad’ – Morobeats

**R&B Song of the Year**

*   ‘Lackin’ – Denise Julia

**Folk Song of the Year**

*   ‘Dear’ – Ben&Ben

**People’s Choice Artist**

*   SB19

**People’s Choice Song**

*   ‘Dungka!’ – SB19

**Concert of the Year**

*   _Pagtatag Finale_ – SB19

**Tour of the Year**

*   _Pagtatag World Tour_ – SB19

**Lifetime Achievement Award**

*   Jose Mari Chan

**Tribute Award**

*   Pilita Corrales

**Music Foundation of the Year**

*   Ang Misyon Orchestra

The hit song from the OPM band has made it to the Billboard Global 200 this week at no. 181, ahead of "Handlebars" by Jennie and Dua Lipa (no. 186) and "Toxic Til The End" by Rosé (no. 194).

"Multo" is a mapanakit song about the yearning for a lost love. The song has been popular on TikTok and was recently used in edits of WillCa, the "[Pinoy Big Brother](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/showbiz/chikaminute/942690/pinoy-big-brother-celebrity-collab-edition-here-is-the-complete-roster-of-housemates/story/)" love team between [Will Ashley](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/showbiz/chikaminute/942683/will-ashley-nation-s-son/story/) and [Bianca De Vera](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/showbiz/chikaminute/942483/bianca-de-vera-opens-up-to-river-joseph-about-will-ashley-i-ll-always-care-about-him/story/).

Cup of Joe's vocalist, [Gian Bernardino](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/lifestyle/content/942027/cup-of-joe-gian-bernardino-will-ashley-bianca-de-vera/story/), admitted to feeling kilig over the WillCa videos.

The song was released as a single last year. It has since fetched over 60 million streams on Spotify. It was also included in Cup of Joe's debut album "[Silakbo](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/lifestyle/hobbiesandactivities/933185/cup-of-joe-drops-debut-album-silakbo/story/)," which dropped in January.

"Multo" has a music video starring [Elijah Canlas and Miles Ocampo](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/lifestyle/hobbiesandactivities/938503/cup-of-joe-drops-multo-music-video-starring-elijah-canlas-and-miles-ocampo/story/).

Cup of Joe's other songs include "Misteryoso," "Tingin," "Estranghero," and "Ikaw Pa Rin Ang Piliin Ko."**—MGP, GMA Integrated News**

Spotify 2025: Cup of Joe leads PH artists, 'Multo' is top song
==============================================================

#### ABS-CBN News

#### Published Dec 04, 2025 12:32 PM PHT

#### |

#### Updated Dec 04, 2025 12:33 PM PHT

![Image 10: Facebook](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/FacebookNews.png)

![Image 11: Twitter](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/TwitterNews.png)

![Image 12: Viber](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/ViberNews.png)

![Image 13: Clipboard](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/ClipboardNews.png)

* * *

![Image 14: Cup of Joe. Photo from Cup of Joe's X account](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/editorImage/1764821559968CUP%20OF%20JOE.jfif)Cup of Joe. _Photo from Cup of Joe's X account_

Baguio-rooted band Cup of Joe emerged as the most-listened-to local artist on Spotify in the Philippines for 2025, with their hit "Multo" topping the list of most-streamed songs.

The music streaming service released Thursday its lists of the top five local artists, groups and songs for 2025 — with Cup of Joe taking the No. 1 spot across all categories.

In the top artists list, Cup of Joe was followed by December Avenue at No. 2, Arthur Nery at No. 3, Dionela at No. 4, and TJ Monterde at No. 5.

![Image 15: Photo from Spotify Philippines' X account](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/editorImage/1764821013931TOP%20ARTISTS.png)_Photo from Spotify Philippines' X account_

![Image 16: Photo from Spotify Philippines' X account](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/editorImage/1764821043631TOP%20GROUPS.png)_Photo from Spotify Philippines' X account_

December Avenue also placed second in the top groups list, followed by Ben&Ben, Parokya ni Edgar and Silent Sanctuary.

ADVERTISEMENT

Cup of Joe's "Multo," a sentimental synth-pop track about being weighed down by memories of a past relationship, was crowned the most-streamed local song on the platform.

![Image 17: Photo from Spotify Philippines' X account](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/editorImage/1764821076650TOP%20SONGS.png)_Photo from Spotify Philippines' X account_

Earl Agustin's "Tibok" followed at No. 2, with Dionela's "Marilag" placing third.

Amiel Sol's "Sa Bawat Sandali," which gained popularity through the series "Ang Mutya ng Section E," ranked fourth, while hip-hop artist Hellmerry's "My Day" rounded out the top five.

**TOP PODCASTS**

Apart from music, Spotify Philippines also unveiled its top podcasts, with Barangay LS 97.1’s "Barangay Love Stories" claiming the top spot, followed by "Papa Dudut Stories."

Relationship podcast "Will Talks" ranked third, with "Dear MOR" placing fourth. Meanwhile, "Sitio Bangungot - Pinoy Horror Stories for Sleep Podcast," which features Filipino horror stories, landed at No. 5.

ADVERTISEMENT

![Image 18: Photo from Spotify Philippines' X account](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/editorImage/1764822223374TOP%20PODCASTS.jpg)_Photo from Spotify Philippines' Facebook account_

In terms of genre, "Barangay Love Stories" was also named the top love and relationship podcast, while "Sitio Bangungot" emerged as the top horror podcast.

"The KoolPals," hosted by stand-up comedians, brought laughter to listeners as the top comedy podcast, while Dani Barretto's "The Bare It All Podcast" was named the top wellness podcast.

"Chicks 2 Go," hosted by Ashley Rivera and Hershey Neri, was recognized as the top new group podcast of 2025, while Sophie Prime's "Dagok Time!" was cited as the top new solo-host podcast, according to Spotify.

Cup of Joe's 'Multo' lands No. 1 spot on Top OPM Songs of 2025 on Apple Music PH
================================================================================

#### Toff C.,

#### Push Team

#### Published Dec 04, 2025 06:44 PM PHT

![Image 5: Facebook](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/FacebookNews.png)

![Image 6: Twitter](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/TwitterNews.png)

![Image 7: Viber](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/ViberNews.png)

![Image 8: Clipboard](https://od2-image-api.abs-cbn.com/prod/ClipboardNews.png)

* * *

Cup of Joe’s “Multo” has landed the No. 1 spot on the Top OPM Songs of 2025 on Apple Music Philippines.

According to a report by All Charts PH on the social media platform X, “Multo” secured the top rank, followed by “Marilag” by Dionela at No. 2, “Dilaw” by Maki at No. 3, “Sining” by Dionela featuring Jay R at No. 4, and “Tibok” by Earl Agustin at No. 5.

Rounding out the Top 10 are “Palagi (TJxKZ Version)” by TJ Monterde and KZ Tandingan at No. 6, “Tingin” by Cup of Joe and Janine Teñoso at No. 7, “Kahel na Langit” by Maki at No. 8, “Namumula” by Maki at No. 9, and “Misteryoso,” also by Cup of Joe, at No. 10.

Cup of Joe recently held a two-day major concert titled _Stardust_ at the Big Dome on October 10 and 11.

ADVERTISEMENT

Back in February, Cup of Joe staged their _Silakbo_ concert at the same venue for two days.

Cup of Joe released their debut studio album _Silakb_ o in January this year.

"Because this is our first major album, we wanted to do something different. Mga previous songs namin very energetic, pero this time we wanted to be very emotional, very raw," vocalist Raphaell Ridao shared about the theme of the album in a previous interview with ABS-CBN News.

"When we look at the songs we created, it was natural to come up with an idea expressing our journey through music and life. This is a compilation of what we experience and our collective raw emotions," he added.

_Silkabo_ contained 10 tracks including the hit song "Multo."

ADVERTISEMENT

In a previous interview with pikapika.ph, the band reflected on why "Multo" became such a massive hit.

"Sobrang daming nakarelate. Na-encapsulate niya talaga ‘yong pinakasense ng yearning, ng longing sa things that could have been, sa regrets, ganyan. And I think maraming nakarelate," vocalist Gian Bernardino remarked.

Guitarist Gabriel Fernandez also shared that the song can be interpreted in different ways by listeners, making it a powerful anthem. "Madaming pwedeng maging meaning ’yan so may mga tao na iba-iba ’yong experience. Parang, in a sense, nakakarelate din sila doon sa song na ’yon, in a different way nga lang," he highlighted.

I raised them alone, and for the first 3 years, ganito na ganito ang naging sitwasyon ko araw-araw. Ramdam ko yung lungkot at sakit na pinapakita sa video mas masakit pa sa lahat ng klaseng heart break. Ang hirap. Araw araw ka bumabangon at gumigising pero pakiramdam mo hindi ka na buo. Palaging may kulang. Madalas ang hirap itaboy yung sakit at lungkot. There were times that its hard to keep my insanity away because of what happened. May mga pagkakataong bigla ka na lang iiyak habang naglilinis, kumakain, naliligo, nagtatrabaho, o kahit nanunuod lang ng TV. Kahit sa pagtulog, ramdam ko pa rin. Lalo na kapag napapanaginipan ko siya, ang mukha niya, boses, tawa, at ang kamay niyang hawak ko. Kahit alam kong panaginip lang, pinipili kong huwag dumilat para makasama ko pa siya kahit sandali lang. Paulit-ulit itong nangyari sa akin. Hindi lang isang beses. Every day felt like hell, not because I’m a single father, but because I missed her so much. The pain of missing someone you truly love iba talaga. Pero kailangan ko magpakatatag para sa dalawang anak namin. Ngayon, 10 and 8 years old na sila. They are my strength, my joy, and I’m beyond lucky to be their dad. A good friend once asked me during our inuman session, "Kung nakikita ka ni Anne ngayon, sa tingin mo ba, masaya siya sa situation mo ngayon?" Sabi pa niya, "For sure, she wants you to find someone. Not to replace her because she’ll always have a special place in your heart but someone who can help fill the void, the space that was left behind." Bigla niya akong tinapik sa balikat at sinabing, "Naniniwala ako, pre. Meron at meron darating ulit sa buhay mo. Mabait kang mister, mabait kang ka-trabaho, mabait kang kaibigan at higit sa lahat, mapagmahal at mabait kang ama." Honestly, hindi ko alam kung ano ang dapat kong isagot. I’ve tried nag-sign up din ako sa dating apps like Bumble, Tinder, and the like. Pero kapag may match, madalas hindi rin nagre-reply. So sabi ko sa sarili ko, okay lang. Kung may darating na tatanggap sa akin at sa mga anak ko, malaking himala na 'yon. At kung paano ko minahal si Anne, handa akong mahalin ang susunod—baka nga higit pa, kasi alam ko na ngayon kung gaano kahalaga at kalalim ang tunay na pagmamahal. Pero ang totoo, ako rin mismo ang may problema minsan. Kasi pagkatapos kong makilala at makasama si Anne, bilang asawa, partner, at mommy ng mga anak namin—parang nagkaroon ako ng standard sa puso ko pagdating sa paghanap muli. Aside sa maganda at mabait, she was one of the few women na siguro bihira mo na lang makilala sa panahon ngayon. Kaya kung wala man dumating, ayos lang din. Focus na lang ako sa trabaho, sa pag-earn, at higit sa lahat, sa mga anak ko. Sila ang buhay ko ngayon. At sa puso ko, alam kong kahit papaano, proud si Anne sa akin. At kahit hindi madali yung situation ko ngayon, natututo akong mabuhay muli para sa mga anak namin. I know each one of us has our own “Multo” that we face from time to time. Let’s make sure that giving up is never part of our system. The only right thing to do is to face them, acknowledge them, get through them, and move on. Sabi nga nila, life must go on.

[#CupofJoeForBBPHStudios](https://www.youtube.com/hashtag/cupofjoeforbbphstudios) Billboard Philippines Studios presents one of the biggest OPM bands of this generation, Cup of Joe, performing some of their most iconic chart-topping anthems, ‘Multo’ and ‘Misteryoso,’ live in an exclusive session that showcases why they continue to dominate the charts and captivate audiences worldwide. Billboard Philippines’ Global No. 1 Artist Of 2025 [#CupOfJoe](https://www.youtube.com/hashtag/cupofjoe) has risen to newfound heights of fame this year with their single ‘Multo,’ a track that holds the record for the longest-running #1 single on the Billboard Philippines Hot 100 chart, broke into the Billboard Global 200 Chart (making them the first Filipino act to place on the charts) and won Song of the Year at the Filipino Music Awards. Lauded, awarded, and acclaimed for their artistry, Cup of Joe celebrates their new title and their successful year with an exclusive live performance of two singles that catapulted a band of friends from Baguio into global stardom. [Cup of Joe](https://www.facebook.com/CupOfJoeRecords?__cft__[0]=AZaZJfytt8ggFqoJj95xz2t4r-6n5kMdNjbhxjLxdhgMGD-d2Sw-6Zaj0zcs2vH6TQmTRzeOl5AXOyfSyQhRFhnruWNm_AW8LKo2myXr1M3VXogb7z0f24XlITi3I5mcM9QxNEGtuRnHL6la7joQkDz2jBeRlkltkj-unKlZucvslA&__tn__=-]K-R) and their biggest song yet, “Multo,” continue to showcase their widespread impact on Filipino listeners nationwide — a fact solidified by officially being the longest-reigning song on the Billboard Philippines charts.

On October 12, 2025 (Sunday), the alternative pop band were presented by Billboard Philippines publisher Anne Bernisca and managing editor Jason Caballa with a plaque of recognition for this feat. It was given to the band during the third day of their ‘Stardust’ Manila concert, held at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.

At the time of being given the award, “Multo” had held the No. 1 spot on the Philippines Hot 100 and Top Philippine Songs charts for 27 weeks straight — the most by any artist in the charts’ history. This achievement is significant as it not only objectively proves that “Multo” is currently the biggest song in the Philippines, but that it has also beaten out other viral and successful songs constantly being listened to by Filipino listeners in the past few months
